Sets

Source: R/sets-ops.R, R/sets.R
sets.Rd

Intervals, finite sets, the standard number sets and set operations, like SymPy's sets module. Interval(a, b) is closed by default; use left_open/right_open or Interval_open(), Interval_Lopen() and Interval_Ropen(). Number sets are Reals, Integers, Naturals (starting at 1), Naturals0, Rationals, Complexes and UniversalSet. Union(), Intersection(), Complement(), SymmetricDifference() and ProductSet() combine sets and simplify when possible. contains() tests membership; measure(), boundary(), set_inf(), set_sup() and is_subset() query sets.

Usage

Interval(a, b, left_open = FALSE, right_open = FALSE)

contains(s, x)

is_subset(s, t)

Union(...)

Intersection(...)

Complement(s, t)

SymmetricDifference(s, t)

measure(s)

boundary(s)

set_inf(s)

set_sup(s)

ImageSet(lam, base)

Interval_open(a, b)

Arguments

a, b

Endpoints.

left_open, right_open

Openness of the endpoints.

s, t

Sets.

x

An element.

...

Elements or sets.

lam

A Lambda().

base

A set.

sym

A symbol.

condition

A boolean condition.

Value

A set expression, or a logical/boolean value.

Examples

Interval(0, 1)
#> Interval(0, 1)
Union(Interval(0, 1), Interval(2, 3), Interval(1, 2))
#> Interval(0, 3)
Intersection(Interval(0, 5), Interval(3, 10))
#> Interval(3, 5)
contains(Interval(0, 1), Rational(1, 2))
#> [1] TRUE
Complement(Reals, FiniteSet(0))
#> Union(Interval.open(-oo, 0), Interval.open(0, oo))
